text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval for 2018 capital projects and major purchases.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the State of Good Repair capital projects listed as New 2018 State of Good Repair Funded Projects and all related purchase orders and/or tender awards up to each individual project budget, as outlined in Attachment 1 to the report (February 23, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Approve the Facility Fee Reserve Fund projects and purchases listed as Facility Fee Reserve Funded Projects and all related purchase orders and/or tender awards up to each individual budget or adjusted budget (if necessary), not to exceed the available Facility Fee Reserve Fund funding, as outlined in Attachment 1 to the report (February 23, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto.
